column1: # friso's traditional -> simplified conversions (`Cn_T2S`) as Redis 8.10.2 (redis:8-alpine,
# bundled RediSearch 8.10.1) applies them to LANGUAGE chinese text, recorded from its
# observable behaviour by gen_t2s.py (see there to regenerate); no module data was used.
# TRAD<TAB>SIMP (hexadecimal code points), then how the entry was observed:
#   single    a one-character document indexes the simplified character
#   context   only inside a dictionary word (the simplified character is no word alone)
#   stand-in  the target is unobservable (no word, no context tells it apart): a
#             character of the same UTF-8 length that behaves identically
